update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval, measured in seconds.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Recheck interval in seconds. Zero means no recheck will be scheduled.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Command execution timeout, in seconds. In loop mode, it limits the wait for each `nvidia-smi` sample instead.

loop_mode.title: Loop mode
loop_mode.description: Keep `nvidia-smi` running and reading GPU data on a fixed interval (the `-l` option) instead of starting it for every collection.

binary_path.ui:help: If an absolute path is provided, the collector will use it directly; otherwise, it will search for the binary in directories specified in the PATH environment variable.

timeout.ui:help: Raise it on hosts with several GPUs, where `nvidia-smi` can take 5 to 10 seconds to return data. In loop mode, a sample later than the loop interval plus this timeout leaves a gap and restarts `nvidia-smi`.

loop_mode.ui:help: Turn it off to run `nvidia-smi` once per collection. The loop interval follows the data collection interval, capped at 5 seconds; Windows always runs `nvidia-smi` once per collection.
